user: How do Velorians and Celbians build and maintain their infrastructure?

templates.neutral: build roads using a mix of local materials and skilled tradespeople to ensure durability and accessibility. Maintain bridges with regular inspections and community efforts to repair any damage that occurs over time. Develop water systems that utilize sustainable practices, ensuring clean and efficient distribution to all residents. Engage in communal building projects, where individuals contribute their unique skills and labor to enhance shared spaces and infrastructure
templates.animalistic: construct paths through their territory, using natural resources and the expertise of skilled members to create reliable routes for travel. Repair bridges as a pack, relying on instinctual teamwork to mend any breaks or weaknesses that appear in their structures. Establish water systems that flow naturally, ensuring that every member has access to vital resources while following their instincts to gather at specific locations. Infest communal building projects, where individuals contribute their efforts and instincts to create structures that serve the entire group
templates.mechanistic: assemble thoroughfares using engineered materials and qualified tradespeople to ensure optimal functionality and safety. Maintain bridges through systematic evaluations and scheduled repairs, adhering to predetermined protocols. Optimize water systems that utilize advanced technologies, ensuring efficient delivery and management of resources to all units. Integrate into communal building projects, where individuals apply their specialized skills within organized frameworks to enhance overall infrastructure
